frames.name: Swift
frames.desc: Fastest frame with the shortest dash recharge. Outrun fire and pick your fights.

frames.name: Quickdraw
frames.desc: Reloads in under half the time, fires 25% faster and recharges tools sooner. Slow, so get into position early.
